title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1969-02-12
lineage: SBD > Cassette Master > DAT > CD > EAC > shntool > mkwACT > SHN

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard capture of a blistering ’69 show highlighted by an incendiary The Eleven and a scorching Alligator > Caution sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as crystal‑clear, with only occasional oversaturation or slight muffling, delivering the full power of a classic early‑’69 set.  Musically the night erupts with a monster Dark Star fragment, a fire‑breathing St. Stephen > The Eleven and an all‑out Alligator > Caution jam that many reviewers call “red‑hot” and “metal‑heavy”.  Even with the missing opening of Dark Star, the performance is described as on‑fire, tight, and one of the best versions of The Eleven ever captured.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews, the vast majority are 5‑star with enthusiastic language about both performance and sound quality; only minor criticisms (missing Dark Star intro, slight oversaturation) appear.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly call the audio superb, crisp and clear; a few note slight oversaturation or mild muffling in spots but overall the mix is balanced with good instrument separation (notably drums).

show_quality.setlist_flow: The early trio – Dark Star, St. Stephen, The Eleven – launches the show at peak energy; the Alligator‑Caution jam sustains that intensity before the set eases but remains strong throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “red‑hot”, roaring Twin tone, blazing fast runs, and on‑fire soloing especially during The Eleven.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for “harmony‑geometric genius” and playing all the right places; his bass lines drive the high‑energy jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Noted for creating a cello‑like feedback tone (quiet low A note) that underpins the Caution jam; overall keyboard work adds spacey textures.
band_member_comments.Drums: Clear separation of the two drummers is highlighted, giving the rhythm section a solid, punchy foundation.
